duration_policy: audio_measured; editorial pauses are explicit timeline events
cut_rhythm: 18-45 seconds per environmental shot; avoid cuts inside a sentence
narration: primary voice track; segment boundaries come from measured WAVs

safe_area.vertical: caption and medallion inside 10% safe margins

music: optional owner-approved track; duck below narration with smooth fades
effects: subtle atmospheric effects only; never mask dialogue
medallion: official approved narrator asset only when the project declares one
